evidence: The authoritative workbook says this row requires no real spelling errors and no accidental pasted material, including author notes, TODOs, stray machine paths, or contradictions (WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx, Quality Checks row 4 and Internal Quality Checks row 4). The brief is clean and concise: task/instruction.md:1 describes the intended JavaScript/HTML playground, line 3 points to exactly six notes and /assets/seed_data.json, and line 5 gives the /app and / runtime surface. Exactly six Markdown files exist under task/environment/instructions. A case-insensitive scan of the brief, all six notes, app_context.md, and all five judge prompts for TODO, FIXME, XXX, CHANGE_ME, <placeholder>, Windows drive paths, /Users/, /home/, author-note markers, and lorem ipsum returned no hits. Manual reading found no duplicated paragraph, pasted author aside, mojibake, replacement character, or spelling error. Deliberate technical terms and names are used coherently: behaviour.md:3 says one-based line number; ui.md:5 uses caret and decomposed accented letters; ui.md:13 uses valid British spelling colour and ui.md:15 uses colouring; Colderwater is consistently the product name in app_context.md:3 and all five prompts. The statements that are most likely to contradict remain aligned: no sign-in appears in instruction.md:5, overview.md:3, policy.md:3, and app_context.md:3; the five-second budget appears as one consistent rule in behaviour.md:5; /assets/seed_data.json is described consistently in instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7; and persistence/restart requirements agree in behaviour.md:7-9 and integration.md:7-9. A conforming alternative using American color/coloring would also pass, while a polished but broken app would not change this source-hygiene verdict because row 3 assesses the authored instruction rather than implementation behavior. The manifest input SHA-256 recomputed to 5da6c5087a3e9ebcbf148f1812ebc608c333956e0667f2c1563b6bacd71baf4b, and every frozen task/rule artifact matched its manifest byte hash (0 mismatches).
